# Per-package statement-coverage floors, checked by tools/covfloor over the
# coverage.out of .github/workflows/coverage.yml (Linux, ubuntu-latest).
#
#   <module-relative package>  <integer floor>   # optional comment
#
# Floors are anti-regression floors, not targets. A package is its directory; its
# coverage is covered statements / total statements of the files in it, counted
# by its own tests. Never lower a line to make a run pass: write the test, or
# justify the change in the PR.
#
# New package: run the coverage command from .github/wiki/Contributing.md, then
#   go run -mod=vendor ./tools/covfloor -profile coverage.out -floors .github/coverage-floors.txt -write
# which appends the missing packages at max(0, floor(measured) - 2) and never
# changes an existing line. A line for a package that no longer has statements is
# stale and fails the gate; delete it with the package.
#
# internal/trust: Linux floor. dns_macos.go and ports_macos.go carry //go:build darwin
# and the darwin-only idempotency suite does not run on Linux, so the Linux
# measurement is far below the macOS one (P103 R1). This gate runs on Linux only.
internal/auth 80
internal/license 60
internal/trust 35
internal/ui 75
